sources.title: Disentangling Length from Quality in Direct Preference Optimization
sources.locator: Introduction；Direct Preference Optimization；Building in Explicit Regularization in DPO；What Drives Length Exploitation?；Limitations
sources.excerpt: they all show significant length bias out-of-distribution
sources.inspection_note: 已讀偏好資料的長度傾向、DPO 的整篇策略／參考比值、額外長度正則項與分布外長度偏差分析。研究顯示參考比值仍可有長度偏差；結論限於作者研究的模型、資料與配方，不是所有任務必然偏長。

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
sources.locator: Direct Preference Optimization：Deriving the DPO objective，顯示式標籤 (7)；What does the DPO update do?
sources.excerpt: the Bradley-Terry model depends only on the difference of rewards between two completions
sources.inspection_note: 已讀 DPO 目標與梯度推導。目標內比較兩篇完整條件機率相對固定參考的 log 比值；這不是正確答案的校準信心，也不是各篇 token 分數平均。整體 margin 增加並不約束 chosen 機率必須獨自增加。

sources.locator: Confounding means we have lost the ability to estimate some effects and/or interactions
sources.excerpt: Confounding means we have lost the ability to estimate some effects and/or interactions
sources.inspection_note: 已讀 confounding 的定義與因子效應不可分離的例子。教材把長度與品質同時改變造成的原因難分稱作混淆，符合這個廣義的設計概念；不把教材例子宣稱為完整的隨機因果實驗。
